newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU committee fails to decide on lira ERM entry.
newsitem.headline: EU committee fails to decide on lira ERM entry.

text.p: The EU's monetary committee ended talks without deciding on the lira's re-entry to Europe's exchange rate mechanism on Saturday, an EU monetary official said.
"The meeting is over. The finance ministers will take it up again tomorrow," the official said.
The official said EU finance ministers were likely meet on Sunday afternoon to discuss the lira's re-entry rate.
A monetary official said earlier that Italy had sought a central rate of 1,010 lire to the German mark but most of its partners wanted a rate below 1,000 lire.
